note: AgriShare test data (fictional). New accounts use password123. Farmer login ID = last 6 digits of RSBSA. Maui Pelaez, Claude Oclarit and Luna Cuizon already exist in the system: link to them by RSBSA number, never recreate or change them. MAO presentation (Nov 22–23, 2026): one allocation (kg per hectare) per commodity — varieties are separate commodities (Rice Seeds – Inbred (RCEF) 40, Rice Seeds – Hybrid 15) — each seeded farmer's Seed program, requests go straight to the MAO (Pending, optionally Recommended by the Farmers' Association President), a distribution with a 2,000 kg barangay allocation by farm size × rate, and harvest reports in kg (identified by harvest date; no Wet/Dry season). Sitios/puroks and farmers' associations come from the managed lists of each farmer's barangay (crops from the crop list) (Nov 24, 2026): test farmers use list entries; the two test associations are added to the list if missing. Announcements (Nov 24, 2026): a title, optional date, time and venue, details, and who can see it — farmers and/or Farmers' Association Presidents, in all barangays or chosen ones. AgriShare covers the barangays of Labangan: farmers belong to their address's barangay and each Farmers' Association President to a barangay; the second test FA President and farmer 000226 are in Bagalupa, a third FA President and farmers 000227–000232 are in Bokong, Combo and New Labangan (with a distribution, requests, proof of planting and harvest reports each), and posts go to single barangays, two barangays and all barangays, so the barangay filters can be tested. The all-barangays post is for Farmers' Association Presidents only, so seeding it on live doesn't notify every real farmer. Association requests were removed from the apps (Nov 23, 2026): none are seeded; older seeded ones stay in the ledger so cleanup can remove them. Barangays use the MAO's official list (Langapud is Langapod). Each Farmers' Association President account has a barangay and sees only that barangay's records.
